brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Level 0 holds six hex bases (full bases at 0,0 / -1,0 / 0,-1 / 0,1 and a half-e at 1,0). Level 1 has a full base at 0,0,1 seated on the level-0 base via a snap. Two storeys total.

Two notch drawer frames (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at -1,-1,0 and hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at -1,1,0) fill empty positions between base pairs on storey 0. The standalone 'drawer' family had no sockets on this build, so notch drawer frames were used instead.
check_build: ok, meshClash 'clear'. Two joint bolts lock the loose-body pair; the only remaining note is an info-level OPEN_CAP_FACE listing faces that could take caps (optional).

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
